newsitem.title: FINLAND: TIETO WINS SYSTEM ORDER FOR 700 STATIONS.
newsitem.headline: TIETO WINS SYSTEM ORDER FOR 700 STATIONS.

text.p: Finnish data services group TT Tieto Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had won an order from automobile inspection firm Suomen Autokatsastus Oy for a software system for about 700 workstations.
TT Tieto did not give the value of the deal and nobody was immediately to comment.
"The system will have about 700 workstations in 100 regions and it will be taken into operation during autumn 1997," it said.
A TT Tieto official later said by telephone that the value of the order for TT Tieto was millions of markka but less than ten million. He said the final figure was hard to estimate.
TT Tieto said in its statement the deal was a continuation of long cooperation between the two companies.
"The system will be one the largest information systems in Finland based on workstation/server technology," it said.
